observed: Result: Blocked until tomorrow — the test itself needs steps on two different days (it checks that two days are not averaged), so it cannot be finished on 12 Oct.
Day 1 is done on the QA branch (12 Oct 2026): user 1 turned VIN/Serial on and off several times and ends with it on; they count as one person.
Day 2 runs automatically on 13 Oct 2026 at 2:00 PM Pakistan time, a time that is already 13 Oct in US and Canadian time zones too, so it cannot fall on the same day as day 1.
No Google Analytics needed: the figures are worked out from what the QA branch sends, with the PRD's rules.
Passed if, after day 2, VIN/Serial comes out at 2 of 4 users = 50% and Total price at 2 of 3 = 66.7% (the user without financial data is left out).
